scope: Core, trace and proposed private ABI and native map adapter. Source review only; the provider audit was not included in the reviewed commit.
required: Snapshot must require initialized, correctly aligned nonoverlapping u64 elements before forming a Rust slice, or write uninitialized storage without forming a u64 reference.
Preserve same-map owner node reinsertion or define paired node disposal if permitted. Review real Group auth, teardown, callback sequence and linkage.
verified: Retained node and scalar token order, assigned-prefix counts in the present native transients, six priorities, scalar widths, and field-based repr(C) reply use.
limits: No link/compile, actual C++ layout test, allocator measurement or pool runtime was run. Native allocation and Rust panic results need configured build evidence.
optional: Require nonempty paired trace output if standalone comparator is used.
worker_correction: The initialized-snapshot requirement was sent during the active production conversion before independent review completed.
